description: Change the shared knowledge base. add creates a node under an existing parent, promoting Markdown leaves only; JSON leaves cannot have child nodes. edit replaces a node's whole text; rm deletes one (recursive: true for a subtree). Start Markdown text with # Title; keep nodes under 2 KB and split when larger. Errors: NodeExists, NodeMissing, TextBad, LockFailed (retry once later), WriteFailed (read-only for you). Details: memory node memory.

path.description: Node path without extension; root is read-only.

text.description: Required for add/edit; full UTF-8 text, at most 8000 bytes. JSON leaves require valid JSON.

recursive.description: Allow rm to delete a whole subtree; root-level symlinks return PathBad; deeper symlinks are only unlinked.
